arStrings.szText: {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Pulverize{/c} pulls Distant enemies towards you. In addition, {c_important}Pulverize{/c} deals {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. This damage bonus is increased to {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 0")*100|x%|]{/c} if the target was pulled towards you, is {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} or a Boss.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
